title: Prove the full-prefix P104 two-source entrance
body:
## Summary

```text
Y27=y, Y26=-y in B9
PR3449's slice admission, index 2^280
  -> complete 2,025-event prefix admission, index 2^868
```

This isolated package closes PR3449's noncone admission question for its fixed two-source correlation. A written necessity/sufficiency argument reduces exact scalar ADD products and native C-factor outputs to 24 explicit Gaussian congruence maps. Exact finite elimination certifies elementary multiplicities `68,153,177,95,19` for pi exponents zero through four, leaving relative index `2^1180` over independent `4B9`. These are algebraic indices, not resource savings or a supplier invoice.

An explicit slice-admitted nine-term source first fails the full prefix at event 1190's D10 quarter read, with requested value `(-1+i)/2`. A separate seven-term source outside `4B9` passes the entire prefix. A literal 2,040-event fixture includes nonzero dirty reference inputs and exact first-collector private erasure. Individual floor halves may round; exactness is defined at completed C factors and scalar ADD products.

Scientific base and final compatibility checkpoint are canonical main `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19009899). This is distinct from Clear1nsight's active general 58-bank/257-event cone classification and encoder. None of its provisional claims is a premise.

Credit PR3449/3426/3406/3416, Clear1nsight's PR3382/3423, ywz65/PR2586, Arham Tahir/PR2665, Tekalign/PR3025, Ross Richardson/PR3068 and the retained native, geometry and compiler lineage. Frozen proof bytes and original notices are retained unchanged, with origins and hashes. No pending predecessor Git commit is a runtime dependency.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the sharp slice entrance leaves other actual Y27/Y26 reads unbound; the displayed source passes the slice and requests a nonintegral D10 addend.
  **After:** all 512 Gaussian Newton columns reconstruct the complete full-prefix matrix. A separate forward-dependency/direct-butterfly implementation matches every matrix row and a separate subgroup-order algorithm reproduces images `868,424,133,19`.
- Registered Python 3.12 normal/optimized replay passes. Both ring algorithms pass all 256 small Z/4 matrices; 256 pair residues and real optimized Git-free acceptance/Boolean-receipt/corrupt-source/missing-source controls pass. The full physical fixture and wrong-cleanup rejection pass.
- Exact committed-byte/source-history and source-export checks pass. All four optimized standalone commands pass in the committed Git-free export, with all 23 files, including its transport receipt, unchanged. Scoped Ruff E,F,B,PLE,PLW,RUF at line length 100 passes. Hosted CI acceptance is unclaimed.

Use an owned external TMPDIR for temporary CLI fixtures. SOURCES.json pins the two unchanged main-branch inputs. PROOF.md, RESULT.json, FIXTURES.json, VERIFY.json and ENGINEERING.md separate the quantified reduction, exact finite certificate, literal fixture and implementation limits.

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only one scoped package is added. The Newton-alphabet/native physical semantics retain their predecessor premises. Actual preparation, physical ownership/routing/restoration, a complete paid consumer, the remaining word, arbitrary multi-source correlations, tensor depth and all-size transfer remain open. The unchanged-profile supplier stop remains. No supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.
